output.scope_note: The paper is a tutorial on Bayesian analysis of temperature-dependent conductivity, using MD-derived Li-ion conductivities of cubic LLZO and Ag-ion conductivities of AgCrSe2; it reports one numeric LLZO conductivity value in the text, so it is in scope.

records.measurement_method: classical MD (MetalWalls, DIPPIM force field) with Nernst-Einstein conversion and Bayesian Arrhenius extrapolation
records.notes: This is the median of the posterior-predicted room-temperature conductivity obtained by extrapolating the Arrhenius fit to MD data at 500-800 K; it is not a measured value. The 300 K value is an extrapolation, and the 95% interval is 75.8 +30.6 -22.5. The unit 'mScm' is as written in the text (the paper's figures use mS cm-1). Activation energy 0.123 ± 0.016 eV is from the same LLZO Arrhenius fit (Section III), reported in text with PDF-garbled symbols. Conductivity kind is not specified (MD-derived via Nernst-Einstein with Haven ratio 1.5).
